newsitem.title: UK: Redland rebounds on optimistic outlook.
newsitem.headline: Redland rebounds on optimistic outlook.

text.p: Shares in UK building materials group Redland Plc, which tumbled over two percent early on Thursday on disappointing first-half results, quickly rebounded after the company forecast a recovery in the second half.
Redland shares dropped as low as 434p in early trade but recovered to trade at 452p by 0817 GMT, up 7-1/2 on the day.
"The headline (first-half) figure looked alarming but the company's statement points to a recovery in the second half and that's what the market is focusing on," one marketmaker said.
Redland announced interim pretax profits of 95 million stg, at the lower end of analysts' forecasts.
The company said trading in the second half to date had matched 1995 levels and was expected to be ahead for the six-month period because of cost savings.
